استتفهوا (form X)
# اِسْتَتْفَهُوا (istatfahū) /is.tat.fa.huː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَتْفَهَ (istatfaha)
# اُسْتُتْفِهُوا (ustutfihū) /us.tut.fi.huː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَتْفَهَ (istatfaha)
# اِسْتَتْفِهُوا (istatfihū) /is.tat.fi.huː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَتْفَهَ (istatfaha)
